text:
Breast ultrasound.
Findings: 5 mm complicated cyst, probably benign (U3).
Conclusion: Short-interval follow-up ultrasound advised in six months.

Echocardiogram.
Findings: LVEF 50%, down from 63% on trastuzumab.
Conclusion: Withhold trastuzumab; cardiology opinion requested urgently. Re-scan in 4 weeks.

Screening mammogram.
Findings: Benign appearances.
Conclusion: Routine recall in 3 years via the screening programme.

CT chest.
Findings: 8 mm part-solid nodule in the left upper lobe.
Conclusion: Further CT in 3 months; if persistent, discuss at lung MDT.

DXA scan.
Findings: Hip T-score -3.1.
Conclusion: Severe osteoporosis. Start bisphosphonate via GP; repeat scan in 2 years.

MRI breasts.
Findings: No suspicious enhancement. Mild background parenchymal enhancement.
Conclusion: Annual MRI surveillance recommended (BRCA carrier).

Ultrasound liver.
Findings: Two hyperechoic lesions, likely haemangiomas.
Conclusion: No further imaging needed.

Echocardiogram.
Findings: LVEF 61%. Normal.
Conclusion: Continue routine 12-weekly echoes during anti-HER2 therapy.

Mammogram right breast.
Findings: 7 mm cluster of pleomorphic calcifications, R4.
Conclusion: Stereotactic biopsy recommended.

Staging bone scan.
Findings: No abnormal uptake.
Conclusion: No follow-up imaging is required on the basis of this study.
